The '''Chandrilan Special Forces''' were an organization that shared their name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spy [[Kell Bircher]] was a member of the Chandrilan Special Forces.<ref name="SW12">[[Star Wars (2013) 12|''Star Wars'' (2013) 12]]</ref>
